requiredProfileEdits.proposedValue: This starter guide currently focuses on the Eeyou of Eeyou Istchee through a Cree government's own community account. Wider Cree coverage still needs research.

Retain this status; one correctly relevant source does not establish a developed profile.

requiredSectionEdits.proposedText: The Cree Nation of Eeyou Istchee identifies its people as Eeyou and locates its homeland primarily in northern Québec, with historically occupied lands in Ontario. Its community account emphasizes distinct local histories alongside shared connections and describes local governments working through regional institutions.

Start with this government's own community descriptions and follow its links to individual First Nations. Research beyond Eeyou Istchee is still needed before this guide can represent the wider range of Cree communities and languages.

actualInspection.method: Actual primary web page opened and read through the web tool on 2026-10-21.
actualInspection.scope: Full substantive introduction, Cree First Nation Communities paragraphs, and named community descriptions through MoCreebec; no external linked community sites or media inspected.
actualInspection.pointers: The Cree Nation of Eeyou Istchee; Cree First Nation Communities; Visit a Cree Community; MoCreebec.

scopeNotes: The old Cow Creek Umpqua publication is unrelated to Cree and should be replaced, not relabelled.
The source distinguishes local First Nations and an Eeyou regional government; these are not a single government for all Cree people.
No census counts, area totals, current officers, present treaty membership or current legal conclusions are asserted.
Keep the broader entry name Cree and kind Wider grouping / peoples. This is a limited starter reading path, not a proposed renaming of all Cree as Eeyou.
Do not add unrelated Plains Cree, Nêhiyaw or other regional assertions from this one page. No map data or canonical source was edited.
